concept: A badge states a status in words on a small fill, so meaning never depends on colour or on the glass behind it.

root.why: a compact pill that carries the status as text, readable without seeing its colour

dot.why: an optional dot repeats the status for scanning lists; it is decoration, the words carry the meaning

neutral.why: the neutral badge uses the quiet glass fill so it does not add a loud mark to the pane

info.why: information uses the accent fill with its computed white text pair

positive.why: success uses the green status fill with white text measured at 5.02 to 1

warning.why: warning uses amber with ink text, because white on amber would fail contrast

critical.why: errors use the red status fill with white text measured at 5.66 to 1

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours drop glass and fills, so a real system-colour border is drawn to keep the shape visible
